initial_prompt:
Precise-object-edit: refit the female Scout robe FRONT garment layer.
Image 1 is the existing long olive Scout robe FRONT layer to edit. Image 2 is the frozen female body only for geometry reference. Image 3 is the approved Woodland Scout outfit on that SAME body, providing approved shoulder and upper-arm fit.
Preserve the existing long open-front robe design in image 1: rustic olive woven fabric, narrow brown leather edges, flax fern embroidery running down both front edges, smooth tailored waist, straight gently widening lower panels, no hip bulges. Keep the open front transparent and keep the two long panels separate. Back panel is already a separate app asset and must NOT be added here.
Refit its shoulders and sleeves to image 2's fixed anatomy and image 3's approved upper-arm ease. Add any needed sleeve width INWARD toward the torso; do not balloon the outer sleeve edges. Continuous natural inner-arm cloth, no skin-exposing slits, no detached strips or extra panels. These are full-length sleeves, not rolled short sleeves. Taper each sleeve smoothly along the forearm to the natural wrist. The cuff should be one small curved brown hem attached to the sleeve, subtly wrapping around the wrist, no bulky hollow ring, bracelet, duplicate flap or disconnected band.
Registration is critical. Full 960×1280 canvas stays fixed with the head/foot spaces. On that canvas: shoulder region x340–620 at y330–400; left wrist centered (304,680), right wrist centered (660,680). Cuffs must stop at the wrists and leave the hands bare. Left cuff spans about x274–335, right cuff x626–690. Maintain hem around y1088. Maintain the original collar and long-panel placement. Cover shoulders fully beneath hair.
Output ONE complete garment FRONT layer on genuine transparency, with transparent neckline, front opening, and spaces outside the body. NO avatar, skin, hands, face, hair, underwear, shirt, trousers, boots, background, back panel, text or detached extra elements. Keep image 1's appearance and geometry everywhere that does not need the small fit correction.
selected_refinement_prompt:
Edit only the INNER sleeve contours on this exact robe. The sleeve on the RIGHT side of the image needs about 20 pixels more olive cloth toward the torso, from its underarm through the elbow and upper forearm (approximately y365 to y620). Move that inner edge LEFT toward the torso; keep its outside edge, shoulder, cuff and wrist position fixed. This closes the long thin slit over the arm on the paper doll. Blend the extra width into the existing sleeve folds. No inserted strip, no enlarged torso, no new panel. Give the LEFT sleeve a very small 5-pixel inward allowance on the same section, moving its inner edge RIGHT.
Keep absolutely everything else unchanged: full canvas registration and size, shoulders, narrow waist/front opening, cuffs, brown edging, fern embroidery, long-panel silhouette, hem. No outward widening. No resizing, recentering or cropping. Full front robe layer only on real transparency; no body, skin, hands, rear panel or background.
